headline.title: This Is Donald Trump’s AI Brain Trust
headline.summary: The article discusses the diverse perspectives within Donald Trump's administration regarding the formulation of U.S. AI policy, highlighting the complexity of the discussions involved. A senior official noted that the debate encompasses multiple viewpoints rather than a simple binary argument.

articles.title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Bringing Real-Time Generative Simulation to Surgical Robotics
articles.summary: NVIDIA has introduced Cosmos-H-Dreams, a new platform aimed at enhancing surgical robotics through real-time generative simulation. This technology is designed to improve training and operational efficiency in surgical procedures by providing realistic, interactive environments for surgeons.

articles.title: How AI is expanding what people do at work
articles.summary: New research from OpenAI reveals that AI tools like ChatGPT are enabling workers to expand their roles and take on a broader range of tasks, effectively reshaping job boundaries. This shift highlights the increasing integration of AI in various workplace functions.

articles.title: Are brain waves the next unlock for physical AI?
articles.summary: Researchers are exploring the potential of using brain wave readings to enhance physical AI models, moving beyond traditional data sources like videos and camera angles. This approach aims to improve the accuracy and functionality of AI systems by incorporating neural activity data into their training processes.

articles.title: Industry Leaders Unite in Open Secure AI Alliance for AI Safety and Security
articles.summary: The Open Secure AI Alliance has been established by industry leaders to enhance AI safety and security through collaboration and open-source practices. This initiative aims to leverage the benefits of open-source software, which is vital for various sectors, including cybersecurity.

articles.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B: Unlocking Agentic Capabilities in a Compact Mode
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced Nanbeige4.2-3B, a compact agentic model featuring 3 billion non-embedding parameters, which excels in various tasks including coding, office applications, and complex tool use. The model is pretrained on 28 trillion tokens using a Looped Transformer architecture, enhancing its reasoning capabilities in mathematics, coding, and science without increasing the number of parameters.

articles.title: AI4PLE: A Methodology for Integrating AI into Product Line Engineering
articles.summary: The article introduces AI4PLE, a new methodology designed to integrate artificial intelligence into Product Line Engineering (PLE) to enhance the reuse-based development of complex systems. By focusing on efficient creation, management, and customization of product families, AI4PLE aims to reduce costs, improve quality, and accelerate time-to-market.

articles.title: SceneActBench: Can Agents Act on the 3D Scenes They See?
articles.summary: SceneActBench is a new benchmark designed to evaluate vision-language model (VLM) agents' ability to perform actions in multi-object 3D scenes, addressing gaps in existing evaluation methods that focus primarily on textual responses or single-object operations. The benchmark encompasses five distinct 3D tasks and operates within a unified agent-environment loop, utilizing PNG images or sampled video frames as input.

articles.title: Probing Latent Colombian Identity Inferences in Qwen2.5-7B with Natural Language Autoencoders
articles.summary: A pilot study investigates the ability of the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct language model to infer aspects of Colombian identity and socioeconomic status from Colombian-Spanish and English prompts. Utilizing Natural Language Autoencoders, the research analyzes the model's internal representations and the subtle linguistic cues that may reveal demographic attributes.

articles.title: SM4RT: Learning Structured Motion Geometry for 4D Reconstruction
articles.summary: The article introduces SM4RT, a method that enhances 4D reconstruction by learning structured motion geometry, addressing the limitations of existing motion perception techniques that treat motion as independent displacements. By incorporating the principles of rigid-body kinematics, SM4RT aims to improve the understanding of dynamic scenes in monocular 3D reconstruction.

articles.title: Integrating Reasoning Systems for Trustworthy AI, Proceedings of the 4th Workshop on Logic and Practice of Programming (LPOP)
articles.summary: The proceedings for the 4th Workshop on Logic and Practice of Programming (LPOP) include abstracts and position papers addressing the integration of reasoning systems for trustworthy AI. The workshop will take place on October 13, 2024, in Dallas, Texas, as a hybrid event alongside the 40th International Conference on Logic Programming (ICLP).

articles.title: Atlas 2 -- Foundation models for clinical deployment
articles.summary: Atlas 2 introduces three new pathology vision foundation models—Atlas 2, Atlas 2-B, and Atlas 2-S—that address performance, robustness, and computational challenges in clinical deployment. These models demonstrate state-of-the-art prediction capabilities, enhancing the potential for their use in computational pathology.
